sections.html:
• Thrombocytosis
    • Reactive — (Most common)
      • Infectious
        • Acute or Chronic
      • Inflammatory
        • IBD
        • Rheumatic disorders
        • Celiac disease
      • Tissue Damage
        • Post-op surgery
        • Trauma
        • Burns
      • Non-malignant hematologic conditions
        • Rebound effect following treatment of ITP
        • Rebound effect following ETOH induced thrombocytopenia
      • Other
        • Post-splenectomy or hyposplenic states (Howell-Jolly bodies on PBS)
        • Non-hematologic malignancy
        • Iron deficiency anemia (most common)
    • Spurious
      • Artifact (redo CBC)
    • Autonomous
      • Essential thrombocytosis
      • Polycythemia Vera
      • Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia
      • Primary Myelofibrosis
